content: During pregnancy, precise insulin titration and frequent blood glucose monitoring are essential. Therefore, it is advised to refer patients to a specialized care team that includes endocrinologists, maternal-fetal medicine specialists, and diabetes care professionals. The use of advanced technologies, such as automated insulin delivery (AID) systems, can be advantageous for certain patients. Additionally, predictive low-glucose suspend (PLGS) technology may help in managing hypoglycemia and achieving optimal glucose control.
